summary: Builds DMX universes from POP primitives treated as fixtures, using channel profile blocks and optional per-primitive routing attributes. It is designed to feed DMX Out POP for device output.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Actively update fixture/universe data for DMX Out POP

key_params.name: autolayout
key_params.note: Automatically assign channels/universes when no routing table is used

key_params.name: routingtable
key_params.note: Assign net, subnet, universe, and optional netaddress per primitive

key_params.name: changap
key_params.note: Channel gap between fixtures during auto layout

key_params.name: quantizeuni
key_params.note: Controls whether fixtures or components can bridge universe boundaries

key_params.name: dmxchan0name
key_params.note: Unique identifier for a DMX channel block

key_params.name: dmxchan0valuetype
key_params.note: How values are iterated and sourced

key_params.name: dmxchan0group
key_params.note: Optional point group for universe creation

key_params.name: dmxchan0attr
key_params.note: Attribute components interleaved into DMX channels

key_params.note: Treat 0-1 values as normalized before resolution scaling

key_params.note: Interleave attribute components by byte order

key_params.name: parmcolorspace
key_params.note: Color space for color parameters when a working color space is active

key_concepts: DMX Fixture POP treats each input primitive as one fixture and builds DMX universe channel data for DMX Out POP.
Auto Layout walks fixtures in primitive order from the starting net, subnet, universe, and channel; routing tables or reserved primitive attributes can override fixture addressing.
Reserved unsigned primitive attributes such as DMXFixtureNet, DMXFixtureSubnet, DMXFixtureUniverse, DMXFixtureChannel, DMXFixtureNetAddress, and DMXFixtureGap provide per-fixture routing control.
The DMX Profile page is a sequential channel definition: attributes, constants, point groups, resolutions, normalized values, block merging, and byte interleaving determine final channel order.
Universe quantization controls whether channel data may bridge universe boundaries by fixture or by component, which matters for multi-component attributes and 512-channel DMX limits.
common_gotchas: Each primitive is a fixture, so primitive order directly affects DMX fixture order.
Unsigned primitive attributes such as DMXFixtureUniverse and DMXFixtureChannel can override routing per fixture.
Interleaving multi-component attributes is profile-sensitive; separate channel blocks when byte/component order matters.
